description: This Java source file defines the AddVoicemailActivity class, an Android activity that allows users to input voicemail details, record audio, and store voicemail entries into a content provider. It includes UI components, handling of recording results, and asynchronous insertion of voicemail data.

classes.name: AddVoicemailActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that facilitates recording and storing voicemails with associated metadata into a content provider.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets layout, injects views, and sets button click handlers.

methods.name: storeVoicemail
methods.description: Builds voicemail object from UI inputs and triggers asynchronous insertion.

methods.name: buildVoicemailObjectFromUiElements
methods.description: Constructs a Voicemail object from user input fields, parsing dates and durations.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles activity results, particularly the voicemail recording result.

methods.name: handleRecordingResult
methods.description: Processes the URI returned from the recording intent and updates UI.

methods.name: handleError
methods.description: Displays error dialogs for exceptions encountered.

methods.name: setDefaultValues
methods.description: Sets default UI values such as current time and package name.

methods.name: startRecording
methods.description: Launches the system audio recorder intent.
